# COMPUTE

Assign the value of an expression to a variable.

## Syntax

```text
COMPUTE target = expression.
```

## Example

```text
COMPUTE bmi = weight / (height / 100) ** 2.
```

`statscraft help COMPUTE` prints the same text in the terminal. [All commands](README.md)
